# (by created_at) of the 110 open, untouched, Figma-linked bug reports.
# WHY: figma-catalog/live/_pages.json scope decides what is a parity target. Four lanes on
# 2026-09-08 found a large share of the OLDER backlog measures against retired frames
# (v1-superseded / tombstone / excluded / held). This file covers the NEWER half and the
# answer is different: 55 of 55 are in-scope. Zero retired. The reporting template is not
# still pointing reporters at retired frames; that problem is confined to the older rows.
# METHOD: figma.getNodeByIdAsync(node) through the Plugin API, then a .parent walk up to the
# PAGE node, then (fileKey,pageId) looked up in live/_pages.json. 52 distinct nodes, 52 found.
#   NOT the node-id prefix - a 13xxx prefix does not imply a v2 page.
#   NOT live/<fileKey>__<page>.tsv  - 2026-08-26 snapshot, top-level frames only.
#   NOT bug-node-index.tsv          - built 2026-08-13, resolved 1 of 7 sampled nodes here.
# Page keys are (fileKey,pageId) pairs on purpose: page id 2003:674 names three different
# pages in three files, with three different scopes.
# ownerW/ownerH are MEASURED, not parsed from the frame name. Four Wallet 2 frames are named
# "(768 x 1024px)" and measure 375 x 812 - see the mislabelled-breakpoint note in the notes
